title: 第14章 指点柳玉姝【新书冲榜求支持】
slug: 修炼狂潮全本免费-修炼狂潮最新章节列表
content_zh:
柳玉姝的瞳孔微微收缩，脸上涌上了一抹晕红，好看极了，在刚才她也被楚云凡的拳势所摄，一时间被楚云凡势如破竹的攻到面前，居然没有反应过来。
一旁的那个保镖见楚云凡收了拳头，不由得松了一口气，收了身上的气势，就像是什么都没有发生过一样。
楚云凡收拳，背手而立，但是此时他的气度和刚才比起来，简直就不像是一个人一样。
被楚云凡惊到了，但是柳玉姝并没有丝毫的生气，相反的还有几分兴奋，道：“你刚刚是突破了吧，我在虚拟网络上看过视频，那个武学大师施展出的炉火纯青的虎魔拳，和你现在就是差不多的！”
楚云凡闻言，点点头，说道：“确实如此，刚才就在那一瞬间，我想通了所有的问题，一口气达到了炉火纯青的境界！”
刚才在柳玉姝的强大压力之下，他进入了一种玄之又玄的境界，终于成功突破到了炉火纯青的境界，想明白了虎魔拳炉火纯青的奥义。
这才刚刚突破，威力瞬间就提升了一个档次，居然能破开柳玉姝的拳影，差点伤到柳玉姝。
当然这也只是那个保镖以为的，楚云凡的虎魔拳突破到了炉火纯青，拳法早就化成本能，控制自如，他要收就收，要放就防，是绝对不会误伤的。
他心中也是感慨，柳玉姝果然是有钱人家的富家千金，居然有钱观看武学大师的武道视频。
在昆仑历时代，武学的传播极为广阔，也不像是超古代文明那样子敝帚自珍，武学大师将自己习武的视频发到网上让其他人学习这都很平常，尤其是虎魔拳这种很基础的武学，光是各种武学大师的教学视频就有上百种，可是问题是，这些视频都是要收钱的，观看一次课程一小时，就是上千块钱，不是真的有钱人，哪里消费得起。
虽然看起来上千块不多，但是当看得人多了之后，就是一笔巨大的财富了。
“我听秦叔叔说，你今天才学的虎魔拳？一天之内居然能真的突破到炉火纯青？本来我也是不信的，但是你居然能在战斗中突破，我就相信了，大概你在这方面的天赋真的很高，比秦叔叔评价的还要高！”柳玉姝说道，虽然说战斗中突破，好像在修行典籍之中经常被提起，但是实际上能够做到的万中无一，还要是机缘巧合才有可能。
她自小上的都是名牌学校，见多了那些被称呼为天才的人物，却也没听说有谁能够做到纯粹战斗中突破的。
“我确实是今天才学的，在此之前也没有那个资源去学的虎魔拳，不过柳小姐你应该是不差钱，怎么现在才想着要学虎魔拳呢？”楚云凡也听到了她之前说的，只学了十天的虎魔拳。
“就是为了一个月后的文武分班，到时候不仅仅会有文化课方面的考核，还会有实战课，我之前主要就是为了全力修炼内功，所以没有修炼过武技！”柳玉姝解释说道，如果是之前，她可能根本懒得和楚云凡解释。
龙不与蛇居，她也不会和一个各方面都很平庸的人多说什么。
“在之前，我们都属于在温室里保护的花朵，也碰不到什么实战的机会，学不学武技都无所谓，但是从文武分班开始就不同了！”柳玉姝说道，“就以你们普通学校来说，肉身境第七重，换血期是决定你们能不能进武科班的一个分水岭，但是在武科班里也分普通班和重点班呢！”
“以我的内功修为，要进入武科班，那根本是无需考虑的问题，但是我要考进的是我们学校武科班中的重点班，甚至我要在我们学校的重点班里争取前十，前三，甚至第一！”柳玉姝伸出了一根葱白的手指，雄心勃勃的说道。“我的下一个阶段目标就是要考入联邦大学，但是你知道联邦大学的录取率有多低么？我必须要力争进我们学校的前十，乃至我们静海市的前十才能够稳入联邦大学！”
“当然，近一些的目标就是考入武科班之中的重点班，除了内功修为之外，最重要的就是实战水平，这也是为什么我要突击修炼虎魔拳的原因，不只是我，我的很多同学也都是这样的！”
楚云凡明白了，虽然都是现在才刚刚修炼虎魔拳，但是其中的原因却是截然不同的，他是因为天资太差了，要抓紧时间修炼内功，才有可能将来有机会考入武科班，出人头地。

content_en:
Liu Yushu's pupils shrank slightly, and a blush appeared on her face. She looked very good-looking. Just now, she was also captured by Chu Yunfan's fist. She was attacked by Chu Yunfan like a powerful force, and she didn't even react.
The bodyguard on the side couldn't help but breathed a sigh of relief when he saw Chu Yunfan withdrew his fist, and calmed down his aura, as if nothing had happened.
Chu Yunfan withdrew his fists and stood with his hands behind his back, but his demeanor at this time was unlike that of a human being before.
Chu Yunfan was shocked, but Liu Yushu was not angry at all. On the contrary, she was a little excited and said: "You just made a breakthrough, right? I watched the video on the virtual network. The masterful Tiger Demon Fist performed by that martial arts master is almost the same as you are now!"
When Chu Yunfan heard this, he nodded and said, "That's true. At that moment just now, I figured out all the problems and reached the level of perfection in one breath!"
Just now, under Liu Yushu's strong pressure, he entered a mysterious and mysterious realm, and finally succeeded in breaking through to the realm of proficiency, and understood the secret of proficiency in the Tiger Demon Fist.
This was just the breakthrough, and the power instantly increased to a higher level. It was actually able to break through Liu Yushu's fist shadow and almost hurt Liu Yushu.
Of course, this was just what the bodyguard thought. Chu Yunfan's Tiger Demon Fist had reached a level of proficiency. His boxing skills had long been turned into functions and he could control them freely.
He was also feeling emotional in his heart. Liu Yushu was indeed a wealthy daughter of a wealthy family, and she actually had the money to watch the martial arts videos of martial arts masters.
In the Kunlun era, martial arts spread extremely widely, and they were not as self-respecting as super ancient civilizations. It was very common for martial arts masters to post videos of their martial arts practice online for others to learn, especially for very basic martial arts like Tiger Demon Fist. There were hundreds of teaching videos from various martial arts masters, but the problem was that these videos all required payment. One hour of watching a class cost thousands of dollars. People who are not really rich can afford it.
Although a thousand dollars may not seem like much, when more people see it, it becomes a huge fortune.
"I heard from Uncle Qin that the Tiger Demon Fist that you just learned today? Can you really break through to a proficient level in one day? I didn't believe it at first, but you were able to break through in battle, so I believed it. You probably have a really high talent in this area, even higher than what Uncle Qin said!" Liu Yushu said, although breakthrough in battle seems to be often mentioned in the training books, in fact it is only possible by chance.
She had attended prestigious schools since she was a child, and had seen many people who were called geniuses, but she had never heard of anyone who could achieve a breakthrough in pure combat.
"It's true that I just learned it today. I didn't have the resources to learn Tiger Demon Fist before that. But Miss Liu, you are probably not short of money. Why are you thinking of learning Tiger Demon Fist now?" Chu Yunfan also heard what she said before, and he only learned Tiger Demon Fist for ten days.
"It's just for the civil and military classes one month later. There will not only be assessments on cultural classes, but also practical classes. I was mainly trying my best to practice internal strength, so I never practiced martial arts!" Liu Yushu explained. If it was before, she might not bother to explain to Chu Yunfan at all.
Dragons don't live with snakes, and she won't say much to a person who is mediocre in every aspect.
"Before, we were all flowers protected in the greenhouse, and we had no chance of actual combat. It didn't matter whether we learned martial arts or not, but things are different starting from the separation of civil and military classes!" Liu Yushu said, "Taking your ordinary school as an example, you are at the seventh level of the physical realm. The exchange period is a watershed that determines whether you can enter the martial arts class, but the martial arts class is also divided into ordinary classes.And key classes! "
"With my internal strength, there is no need to consider entering the martial arts class. But what I want to get into is the key class in our school's martial arts class. I even want to be in the top ten, top three, or even first in the key class in our school!" "Liu Yushu stretched out a green-white finger and said ambitiously. "My next goal is to be admitted to the Federal University, but do you know how low the admission rate of the Federal University is? I must strive to be among the top ten in our school, and even among the top ten in our Jinghai City, to be able to securely enter the Federal University! "
"Of course, the immediate goal is to be admitted to a key martial arts class. In addition to internal strength, the most important thing is actual combat level. This is why I want to practice Tiger Demon Fist unexpectedly. It's not just me, but many of my classmates are like this! "
Chu Yunfan understood that although both of them had just started practicing Tiger Demon Fist, the reasons were completely different. It was because his talent was so poor that he had to seize the time to practice his internal skills so that he might have the opportunity to be admitted to the martial arts class and stand out in the future.
